description: This file defines a class Redis within the Opencart system for implementing caching functionality using Redis. It provides methods to connect to Redis, get, set, and delete cache entries, and manages expiration times.
external_methods: php Redis class methods: pconnect, get, set, expire, del

classes.name: Redis
classes.description: A caching class that interacts with Redis to store, retrieve, and delete cache data with support for expiration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets default expiration time.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value corresponding to a key, decoding the JSON stored in Redis.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in cache with a specified expiration time, encoding the value as JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cached entry by key.
